method: independent source, contract, controlled-vocabulary, exactness, closure, historical-labeling and no-fallback audit
rationale: The carrier policy enforces one root clock and one location, exact synchronized slices, capacity/access gates, fail-closed stranding, and two explicit rescue transitions bound to approved activity profiles; only the narrow stable co-located transfer has a reconstructed ten-minute duration.
limitations: The ten-minute transfer is a bounded gameplay reconstruction and cannot be reused when its exact stable/co-located/capacity preconditions do not hold.
